exceptions.reason: Source-build pilot kept intentionally. Today Debian carries only 0.3.0-1 (forky/sid — rolling parity, advisory anyway; trixie-backports 0.3.0-1~bpo13+1), while we build the current 0.3.1, so we are ahead of Debian on every released suite. This exception is a guard: if a RELEASED suite (trixie, incl. a backports-inspired base upload) reaches >= our upstream version, it suppresses the RETIRE hard-stop so the pilot can keep providing Ubuntu LTS and backports coverage until reviewed.
